title: Wall Mount Two-Tiered Glass Shelf 16-Inch Solid Brass | Montero Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Organize your bathroom with the space-saving Montero 16-inch two-tiered glass shelf, a sophisticated storage solution that combines modern geometric design with enduring strength. Crafted from solid brass and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass, this double-tier unit provides ample room for toiletries while maintaining a minimalist profile. Part of the coordinated Montero collection, it features beveled edges and concealed screw mounting for a clean, architectural appearance.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted design maximizes vertical space and keeps surfaces clear
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass provides superior safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware ensures long-term durability in humid environments
- Concealed screw mounting provides a seamless, professional installation
- Available in 28 designer finishes to match any contemporary decor

Specifications:
- Dimensions: 16-In L x 8.3-In H x 5.7-In W
- Material: Solid Brass and Tempered Glass
- Glass Thickness: 0.38-In
- Weight Capacity: 4 lbs
- Includes: Glass shelf, brass hardware, and installation screws
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
